svg.aria-label: Left: training/validation negative log density; dotted line is the true distribution scored on validation points. Middle: normal and vertically shifted score histograms with a validation-set threshold. Right: 64D Gaussian radius density, blue left axis, and point density relative to origin, orange right axis.
